Loan Origination Design

Last updated by the lending architecture team.

Solution overview

Every Loan starts in the Loan Origination Platform. The Loan Origination Platform sends each application to the Credit Decisioning Engine for a decision.

Lending to small businesses grows every year, so Credit decisions must take minutes, not days. The Credit Decisioning Engine reads the credit report from the Credit Bureau Gateway.

Once approved, the Loan is booked in the Loan Book and the Collateral Register records any security.
